method: API evaluator 1.0: three caption-blind observers each received only the image inside the request; a coder, run 2 times, received only the contract and their answers split into numbered units and cited a unit for each finding; code verified every citation and computed the verdict, which passes only when every coding passes (scripts/lib/adjudication.mjs). AI review is not clinical approval.

observers.label: Caption-blind observer 1 (Claude)

answers.1: A person's head and upper neck, drawn as a cartoon-style illustration, seen from behind and slightly to the side (rear three-quarter view). The right ear, cheek edge, eyebrow, eyelashes and nose tip are visible at the right; the back of the head and the nape fill the left.
answers.2: The hair is dark and full on top, with the sides and back clipped very short/shaved so bare scalp shows. Just behind and above the ear there is a soft round patch of red-pink blush on the skin, strongest right behind the ear and fading outward toward the crown and down toward the neck. Inside that red patch sits a thin curved black line, like a crescent or hook, following the curve behind the ear from above the ear top down to the level of the earlobe — it looks like a drawn line or a fine mark on the skin, I am not sure which. No bandage, jewellery, glasses or other worn object. Skin is otherwise smooth and even, with no bumps, crusts or openings drawn.
answers.3: No words, numbers, arrows or labels anywhere. The only non-body drawing is the thin black crescent line behind the ear, which appears to point out the spot at the centre of the red area.
answers.4: A worried patient might read it as a fresh cut or surgical stitch line behind the ear with infection spreading around it, rather than simply a marked sore or tender spot.
